Name of Test Case: Inspect event detail modal by clicking calendar cell
Action to Take: Click on 'Community Outreach Day' event entry in the grid.
Expected Outcome: Event detail modal opens showing date, time, location, host ministry, and full event description.

Name of Test Case: Staff opens '+ Add event' modal and creates new event
Action to Take: Sign in as staff, click '+ Add event', fill in title 'Church Picnic', date, time, location, and click Save.
Expected Outcome: Calls POST /events with event JSON; returns created event; reloads calendar with new item visible.

Name of Test Case: Validate required fields in event creation form
Action to Take: In '+ Add event' modal, leave title empty and click Save.
Expected Outcome: Form validation halts submission; highlights empty title field with required error.

Name of Test Case: Staff deletes or cancels scheduled event
Action to Take: Open event detail modal as staff and click 'Delete event' button with confirmation.
Expected Outcome: Calls DELETE /events/:id; event is removed from calendar display.

Name of Test Case: Automatic AI bulletin summary generation on event creation
Action to Take: As staff, create a new calendar event and check for automated AI bulletin summary.
Expected Outcome: AI endpoint generates welcoming 2-sentence bulletin summary.

Name of Test Case: Export calendar gatherings to Apple iCal / .ics file
Action to Take: Click 'Add to calendar' / export button on an event detail view.
Expected Outcome: Downloads standardized .ics file for importing into Apple Calendar or Outlook.
